title: Latent Coherence: Do Frontier Language Models' Probability Judgments Obey the Law of Total Probability?
abstract: arXiv:2610.31833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LawZero's Scientist AI trains a Predictor toward the Bayesian posterior, with an objective that penalizes inconsistent probabilities among latent explanations. We ask whether current frontier language models, with no such training, are already consistent in this sense zero-shot: do their probability judgments satisfy the law of total probability, $P(X)=\sum_z P(z)P(X|z)$, when the latent $z$ must be inferred from records in the context? In separate single-turn calls, models are asked for $P(X)$, for $P(z)$ over the latent's states, and for $P(X|z)$; a causal family applies the same test to $P(y|do(x))$ and the back-door adjustment. Every query has an exact ground-truth probability, and a subset of items is asked in three wordings to separate persistent incoherence from rewording noise. Across seven models, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 are the most coherent (mean absolute residual 0.08 and 0.12 log-odds, about 2 percentage points). Cla

translated_title: 潜在一致性：前沿语言模型的概率判断是否服从全概率定律？
translated_abstract: LawZero 的 Scientist AI 训练一个预测器（Predictor）向贝叶斯后验逼近，其目标函数会惩罚不同潜在解释之间不一致的概率。我们由此提出问题：当前的前沿语言模型在未经此类训练的情况下，是否已经在零样本意义上具备这种一致性——当潜在变量 z 需要从上下文中的记录推断出来时，模型的概率判断是否满足全概率定律 P(X)=∑_z P(z)P(X|z)？在相互独立的单轮调用中，模型被分别要求给出 P(X)、潜在变量各状态上的 P(z)，以及 P(X|z)；此外还设置了一个因果推断系列，将同样的检验应用于 P(y|do(x)) 和后门调整。每个查询都对应一个精确的真实概率值，且其中一个题目子集以三种不同措辞提问，以区分持续性不一致与措辞变化带来的噪声。在七个模型中，GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 表现出最高的一致性（平均绝对残差分别为 0.08 和 0.12 对数几率，约合 2 个百分点）。
tldr: 该论文首次系统性地检验前沿语言模型在零样本条件下的概率判断是否满足全概率定律及因果后门调整，发现 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 等模型已自发表现出接近贝叶斯后验的潜在概率一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates whether frontier language models' zero-shot probability judgments obey the law of total probability and causal back-door adjustment, finding that models like GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 already exhibit near-Bayesian latent coherence without any such consistency-based training.
